selected_panel.privacy_note: Only the panel selector was retained; the complete bootargs contained a device identifier and is not recorded.

dram.note: The bootloader supplies the memory reg; the Linux SoC DTS intentionally leaves its size zero.

initial_dts_decisions.reason: The running target reports SoC ID 305, revision 1.1, and MSM8996pro.
initial_dts_decisions.uart_evidence: Stock lithium DTB enables serial@075b0000 (gpio4/5) and disables the 0x7570000 lsuart; see console_uart.correction.
initial_dts_decisions.framebuffer_reason: Not hard-coded: lk2nd cont-splash measures the live scan-out and inserts simple-framebuffer at boot with lk2nd.pass-simplefb (docs/DISPLAY.md). Verify at P5.
initial_dts_decisions.xiaomi_common_dtsi: Not included: it enables NFC, IR, Type-C, modem, audio, GPU with sibling GPIOs.

unknowns: whether the console UART pads (gpio4/5) are externally reachable on this unit
TUSB320L address actually populated and its interrupt line
Xiaomi PIL carveout layout on lithium (needed only for remoteprocs, P7)
simple-framebuffer values produced by lk2nd on lithium (P5)
presence of dome/hall/camera keys on lithium

evidence_tooling.decompile: pinned kernel dtc -I dtb -O dts -s artifacts/stock/audit/boot.img.dtb-5
evidence_tooling.built_vs_stock_check: scripts/verify_lithium_dtb.py (39 checks; negative control with mutated DTB fails 3)

reserved_memory_policy.decision: Keep the mainline msm8996.dtsi carveouts (0x85800000-0x91700000, contiguous, all inside the stock removed/modem/peripheral regions) and add only what mainline lacks.

added.reason: tail of stock peripheral_region (0x8fe00000+0x2b00000) not covered by mainline carveouts

not_added.rmtfs: stock qcom,rmtfs_sharedmem has no fixed address (reg <0 0x200000>); mainline dynamic rmtfs kept
not_added.ramoops: lk2nd (WITH_LK2ND_RAMOOPS) inserts its own ramoops node

reserved_memory_policy.deferred_to_P7: The Xiaomi MSM8996 PIL layout (mpss 0x89c00000, adsp 0x8fe00000 ... venus ending 0x92900000) fits lithium's stock envelopes exactly, but is only needed when remoteprocs are enabled.
reserved_memory_policy.verified: every stock static reservation covered; every built static reservation inside a stock one

regulators.always_on: project safety choice: shared 1.8 V I/O rail; stock does not mark it always-on

consumers: ufsphy vddp-ref-clk (not in mainline binding; rail already on via vccq)

not_described_rails.pm8994_l14, pmi8994 lab/ibb, tlmm gpio40: display rails left untouched so the bootloader splash survives
not_described_rails.qusb vdd: stock uses pm8994_s2_corner (VDD_CX corner); mainline has no regulator for it, left unset as on upstream Xiaomi boards (dtbs_check warning shared with scorpio)

storage.vdd_hba: stock gdsc_ufs; mainline uses the SoC power-domain

usb.controller: ssusb@6a00000 (dwc3), HS PHY qusb@7411000, SS PHY ssphy@7410000 enabled in stock
usb.typec: ti,tusb320l declared at 0x47 and 0x67 on i2c@75b7000 (mainline blsp2_i2c3) without interrupts; mainline binding needs one -> not described
usb.first_boot_choice: dr_mode peripheral, maximum-speed high-speed, HS PHY only, qcom,select-utmi-as-pipe-clk (bring-up choice, not a hardware claim)

console_uart.address: 0x75b0000 (mainline blsp2_uart2, downstream serial@075b0000 msm-lsuart, status ok)
console_uart.pins: gpio4/gpio5, function blsp_uart8, bias-disable, 2 mA (stock uart_console_active) = mainline blsp2_uart2_2pins_default
console_uart.correction: serial@07570000 (BLSP1 UART2) is DISABLED as an lsuart in lithium stock; 0x7570000 is the high-speed UART (uart@07570000). The first DTS build pointed stdout there.

keys.not_described: stock gpio_keys also lists dome (TLMM 34), cam_snapshot (PM8994 GPIO 4) and hall_key0 (TLMM 124); shared Xiaomi include, physical presence on lithium unverified
